5398 phoberos {fob-er-os'}

源於 5401; 形容詞

欽定本 - fearful 2, terrible 1; 3

其同義詞, 見 5835
record.edic_text:
5398 phoberos {fob-er-os'}

from 5401;; adj

AV - fearful 2, terrible 1; 3

1) inspiring fear, terrible, formidable
2) affected with fear, timid

For Synonyms see entry 5835
